8b8599388f13fbb5aaae09e3d0e0af3f0f9911b8.translatedText: The most important lines here are:

8bd87851edeec98ba03326814f3067b522352556.sourceText: `joy` 第6个按钮可触发；`cloud_clearing` 的 Float32 消息还会用消息数值覆盖半径。近场节点对应话题是 `map_clearing`，二者不同。扩展节点清图后仍会借入 `terrain_map` 的近场结果，因此近场点可以继续出现在合并输出中；不能把清自身缓存理解为清掉整套地图。本轮没有发送清图事件。
8bd87851edeec98ba03326814f3067b522352556.translatedText: `joy` The 6th button can be triggered;`cloud_clearing` Float32 messages will also override the radius with the message value\. The topic corresponding to the near\-field node is `map_clearing`, and the two are different\. After the extended node clears the map, it will still borrow `terrain_map` near\-field results, so near\-field points can continue to appear in the merged output; clearing its own cache cannot be understood as clearing the entire map\. No map\-clearing event was sent in this round\.
